title: Krosos
description: Your accounting ledger as typed tools: net worth, holdings, history, tax estimates, trade logging.
summary: Your accounting ledger as typed tools: net worth, holdings, history, tax estimates, trade logging.
offersHint: Your accounting ledger as typed tools: net worth, holdings, history, tax estimates, trade logging. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://app.krosos.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_dashboard
toolsPreview.description: Net worth, balance sheet and current holdings, in the ledger's base currency.

toolsPreview.name: get_net_worth_history
toolsPreview.description: Historical net-worth snapshots (one point per day where recorded).

toolsPreview.name: list_transactions
toolsPreview.description: Transaction history as a human-friendly list, newest first.

toolsPreview.name: get_reference_data
toolsPreview.description: Valid accounts, providers, tickers, asset classes and categories. Read this before writing: trades and adjustments must use these values unless allow_new_values is set.

toolsPreview.name: get_tax_report
toolsPreview.description: Capital-gains / income tax estimate for a year: gains, losses, exemption (including any carried-forward amount), taxable base and estimated tax.

toolsPreview.name: get_projection_config
toolsPreview.description: The forecast/FIRE plan's assumptions (salary, expenses, inflation, retirement dates, tax mode). The projection itself is computed client-side.

toolsPreview.name: log_trade
toolsPreview.description: Log a trade (buy / sell / swap), expressed as from-asset to to-asset. Same body and validation as POST /api/transactions.

toolsPreview.name: record_balance_adjustment
toolsPreview.description: Record a signed quantity change on one holding (a balance update that is not a trade). Same body and validation as POST /api/position-adjustments.
